debugData.name: Rock scatter
debugData.description: Scatter rocks (p308 D5; generateRock's, or an imported rock's own maps): input surface the texture set ({ textureSet }), the ground's for the procedural rocks (no texture memory of their own), triplanar in the rock's own space (each instance of an InstancedMesh keeps its texture), DUAL_SCALE anti-tiled; macro a macro texture (the tint at the world's position); dustColor (default the set's averageColor) on the faces turned up; wet by the surface conditions with frost. Numbers (optional inputs): sharpness, farScale, antiTilingDistance, macroScale, macroBrightness, macroHue, macroRoughness, dustAmount, dustFacing. Static defines: tiling (TRIPLANAR, or UV: an imported rock's own maps at its UV), antiTiling (DUAL_SCALE, NONE), wet (FULL, SIMPLE, NONE), frost (boolean), rainOcclusion (NORMAL_Y, MAP). Rocks on another ground set: a material JSON of its own over that set (and a two-line TSL file: export const setup = setupRockMaterial).
